# Drop maximize action and add fieldLabels in Neo.board.CardEditor

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

`Neo.board.CardEditor` (`src/board/CardEditor.mjs`) is the board's shared non-resizable record-editing dialog (`resizable: false`, `draggable: false`, `closeAction: 'hide'`). During Cycle-1 review of PR `#21738` (`examples/board/cardEditor`, `Resolves #21630`), two concrete component gaps surfaced:

1. Unlike its sibling `Neo.timeline.EventEditor` (`src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:68-70`, updated in `#21723` / PR `#21727` with `headerConfig: {actions: ['close']}`), `CardEditor` leaves `headerConfig` unset and inherits `Neo.dialog.header.Toolbar`'s default `actions: ['maximize', 'close']`, rendering a `far fa-square` maximize button that stretches a compact 4-to-9-field card form across the entire viewport.
2. `#21222` (`Avoided Traps`) explicitly ruled out *"A subclass per consumer"* for `CardEditor`, yet `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs` (`35` lines) had to subclass `Neo.board.CardEditor` and override `getStandardFieldConfigs()` with a module-scope `const labels = {...}` map solely to rename four standard field labels (`Title` -> `Name`, `Status` -> `Stage`, `Tags` -> `Role`, `Assignees` -> `Recruiter`).

Design authority: `#21222` (*"Avoided Traps: A subclass per consumer"* on `Neo.board.CardEditor`), `#21723` / PR `#21727` (`src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:68-70` `headerConfig: {actions: ['close']}` on non-resizable record editors), and `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs:56-68` (`{[isDescriptor]: true, merge: 'shallow'}` extensible label-map config idiom).

## The Problem

- **Unintended maximize control on a fixed-size form dialog:** `src/board/CardEditor.mjs:88-114` sets `draggable: false` and `resizable: false`, and `resources/css/src/board/CardEditor.css` sizes the editor as a compact modal card form (`440px` wide). Leaving `maximize` enabled in `Neo.dialog.header.Toolbar` (`src/dialog/header/Toolbar.mjs:39`, `actions: ['maximize', 'close']`) adds header noise and lets an accidental click blow the form to `100vw × 100vh`.
- **Missing declarative label-override seam (`fieldLabels_`):** When a board passes `cardEditorConfig: {fields: ['title', 'status', 'tags', 'assignees']}` with string field names so standard fields retain their built-in widgets and column-derived options (`SelectField` options from `getStatusOptions()` / `getLaneOptions()`, comma-list parsing for `assignees` / `tags`), there is no config on `CardEditor` to customize `labelText` without either repeating full field configs (losing `getStatusOptions()` / `getLaneOptions()` wiring) or creating a `CardEditor` subclass per domain (`CandidateEditor`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.dialog.Base` merges `headerConfig` into `Neo.dialog.header.Toolbar` (`src/dialog/header/Toolbar.mjs:39`). Setting `headerConfig: {actions: ['close']}` on `CardEditor.config` matches `src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:70` while still allowing any consumer to opt back into `{actions: ['maximize', 'close']}` via `cardEditorConfig: {headerConfig: {actions: ['maximize', 'close']}}`.
- `isDescriptor` + `merge: 'shallow'` (`import {isDescriptor} from '../core/ConfigSymbols.mjs'`, as used in `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs:61-71`) merges consumer-supplied entries over the class defaults cleanly per instance without mutating the prototype map.
- **Accretion Defense (`AGENTS.md`):** Adding `headerConfig` and `fieldLabels_` to `src/board/CardEditor.mjs` directly retires `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs` (`35` lines deleted), simplifying `examples/board/cardEditor/Viewport.mjs` to configure `cardEditorConfig` declaratively with zero subclass.

## The Fix

1. **Default `headerConfig` to `{actions: ['close']}` in `src/board/CardEditor.mjs`:**
   - Add `headerConfig: {actions: ['close']}` to `CardEditor.config` with JSDoc matching `src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:67-70`.
2. **Add reactive `fieldLabels_` (`merge: 'shallow'`) config to `src/board/CardEditor.mjs`:**
   - Import `{isDescriptor} from '../core/ConfigSymbols.mjs'`.
   - Declare `fieldLabels_` on `CardEditor.config`:
     ```js
     fieldLabels_: {
         [isDescriptor]: true,
         merge         : 'shallow',
         value         : {
             assignees  : 'Assignees',
             color      : 'Color',
             description: 'Description',
             dueDate    : 'Due date',
             lane       : 'Lane',
             progress   : 'Progress',
             status     : 'Status',
             tags       : 'Tags',
             title      : 'Title'
         }
     }
     ```
   - Read `me.fieldLabels` in `getStandardFieldConfigs()` (resolving `labels[titleField] ?? labels.title`, `labels[statusField] ?? labels.status`, `labels[laneField] ?? labels.lane`, and `labels[name]` for the remaining standard fields) and in `createModelFieldConfig(name, fieldDef)` (`me.fieldLabels?.[name] ?? Neo.capitalize(Neo.decamel(name).replace(/-/g, ' '))`).
   - Implement `afterSetFieldLabels(value, oldValue)` so runtime updates (`oldValue !== undefined && this.form`) rebuild fields and re-sync `this.record` when bound.
3. **Retire `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs`:**
   - Delete `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs` and update `examples/board/cardEditor/Viewport.mjs` (`L2`, `L31`, `L91-92`) to drop `cardEditorModule: CandidateEditor` and pass `fieldLabels: {assignees: 'Recruiter', status: 'Stage', tags: 'Role', title: 'Name'}` inside `cardEditorConfig`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.board.CardEditor` defaults `headerConfig` to `{actions: ['close']}` and renders no maximize button unless overridden via `headerConfig`.
- [ ] `Neo.board.CardEditor` exposes `fieldLabels_` (`[isDescriptor]: true, merge: 'shallow'`) covering standard fields (including custom `board.statusField` / `board.laneField` / title field mappings) and model-derived fields (`createModelFieldConfig`), and updates rendered labels when `fieldLabels` is mutated at runtime.
- [ ] `examples/board/cardEditor/CandidateEditor.mjs` is deleted and `examples/board/cardEditor/Viewport.mjs` uses `cardEditorConfig: {fieldLabels: {assignees: 'Recruiter', status: 'Stage', tags: 'Role', title: 'Name'}, ...}` with `Name`, `Stage`, `Role`, and `Recruiter` labels preserved.
- [ ] Unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs` assert default `headerConfig.actions` (`['close']`), `fieldLabels` shallow merge on construction, and runtime `fieldLabels` updates; existing E2E spec `test/playwright/e2e/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs` passes (`npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs`).

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.dialog.Base` or `Neo.dialog.header.Toolbar`'s default `actions: ['maximize', 'close']` for general-purpose resizable dialogs (`#21374`, `#21201`).
- Custom field widget types beyond `CardEditor#fields` object entries (already supported by `src/board/CardEditor.mjs:460-463`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Replacing the whole `fieldLabels` object without `merge: 'shallow'`:** Without `[isDescriptor]: true, merge: 'shallow'`, passing `fieldLabels: {title: 'Name'}` would wipe out the other eight default standard labels (`Status`, `Tags`, etc.).
- **Keying `getStandardFieldConfigs()` only on literal `'status'` / `'lane'` when `board.statusField` or `board.laneField` is customized:** Check `labels[statusField] ?? labels.status` (and similarly for `titleField` and `laneField`) so both domain-keyed and role-keyed label overrides work.
- **Running bare `npx playwright test`:** Always target Neo's explicit Playwright configs (`npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs`).
